svg.title: The carry is a chain, and the chain is the clock
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The carry is a chain, and the chain is the clock” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A whiteboard sketch building a half adder from an XOR and an AND gate, then a full adder from two half adders and an OR gate, then four full adders wired in a row computing 0111 plus 0001 with the carry drawn as thick red arrows travelling right to left through every stage, and a bar chart comparing ripple-carry gate depth of 19 to 259 against Kogge-Stone depth of 12 to 28 for adders four to sixty-four bits wide.
svg.text: The carry is a chain, and the chain is the clock
draw it from memory, then compare
